material_recipes.insulator_v1: Constant original nonmetal base(.018,.016,.014), roughness.42; no image, atlas bake, normal/bump or private gray master read. build_v2.py/parameters-v2.json are outside this v1 audit and not called by frozen v1 recipe.

manifold_v1.input: Exact supplied topology BLEND pinned by topology-report.json; geometry BLEND/report supplied; no external high-poly master
manifold_v1.generator: Blender Noise4D local metres, W52.18, Detail0, spacing.00022m; bumpDistance.000012m, roughness.42–.56 (art estimates)
manifold_v1.bake: Cycles CPU16 samples; tangent NORMAL OpenGL + EMIT roughness,2048²,12px margin, use_clear=False neutral normal(.5,.5,1) androughness.49
manifold_v1.maps: Two supplied source PNGs, packed in .blend, //textures/ relative; GLB embeds native export textures. No photo-pixel or atlas master input.
manifold_v1.randomness: Fixed Noise W52.18, no Python/NumPy RNG input; exact bitwise output across Blender/CPU versions not established

findings.finding: No indispensable private authored gray/image/geometry master found in the executed v1 recipes.

manifold recipe.py hardcodes /workspace/wewa-tools/blender-4.3.2-linux-x64/blender. This is an external matching-version binary, not a hidden authored asset. control_geometry invokes shutil.which(python) for csg.py: manifold3d/numpy must be installed in that system Python, separately from Blender bundled modules.

check_material_export.mjs writes diagnostic PNG/UV dumps to /workspace/wewa-assets/work-in-progress/engine-intake-manifold/exported-v1-textures; check_exported_map_pixels.py reads them. They can be regenerated from supplied public GLB in that order; no original master promotion needed. Preview paths are output/checkpoint history, not manufacture texture inputs.
findings.additional_diagnostic_environment_limit: Pillow used by check_exported_map_pixels.py is not pinned in tools/requirements-assets.txt. No Pillow dependency for the Blender fabrication/bake.

findings.finding: insulator working-packaging-check.json refers to an earlier64907498/63acffb7 source/export pair, not frozenac925520/14d3eea5. It is not proof of a later relocation or recipe input of current v1. relink_working_stage.py and unrelocated BLEND are not required by build.py.

manifold recipe/build/topology/material refuse an existing frozen preflight. Rebuild belongs only in a new isolated working revision; no freeze was edited. No clean-clone rebuild, bit-identical regeneration, relocated-context opening, artistic/OEM or iPhone acceptance is claimed.

Current insulator path-resolution evidence is reference-path-check.json bound to ac9255209957fafcdd0fe59909cff0af379740526d67b0105fbee3b3a40e765c. Its direct relative head path agrees with statically stored Library data. The older packaging diagnostic is not attributed to this gel. No relocated-checkout test occurred.
